method.source: Cached ArchiveCraft HTML bodies only; no network requests or media downloads. Python standard library HTMLParser extracts img src, enclosing href, title/heading and nearby paragraph; exact route checks use local file paths and provenance route maps. Candidate status requires page-topic/path/role alignment; filename-only overlap is a rejection signal, not a positive match.
method.media_validation: No candidate image bytes are locally present from ArchiveCraft media URLs. Therefore no content-type, image decode, dimensions, frame count, pixel or hash comparison was performed for candidate media.

candidate_media.match_reason: The cached ArchiveCraft page is the Burning Crusade Professions guide and directly places this URL in its page-title role; its topical path is townhall/burning-crusade/professions and the local professions page requests the corresponding images/professions/page-title.png banner. This uses page identity, path context and presentation role, not basename alone.
candidate_media.planned_download_is_not_valid_image: The media URL was only read from cached HTML. No media request or local media file was made; HTML width/height attributes are not image validation.

candidate_media.required_followup: If acquisition proceeds, fetch the media separately, record response time/length/hash/content type, decode and inspect dimensions, then compare with any recovered original source entity before deciding route reuse or replacement.
